summary: Every legal input has exactly four decimal digits, so the workload has no scalable size axis on which an honest asymptotic runtime verdict can be measured.

workload_bound.source_constraint: num is an integer from 1000 through 9999 and therefore always has exactly four digits

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference extracts and sorts exactly four digits, then evaluates one fixed arithmetic expression.
Regression checks all 9000 legal inputs against independent enumeration of every digit permutation and every nonempty split.
